target: TI AM13: ports of MSP430 idioms (reported from vendor documents, with tested traps from runs on the board)

impl.replace: No FRAM. Use the last sector (2 kB) of flash bank 1; the program lives in bank 0. DL_Flash_program(addr, buf, bytes) and DL_Flash_eraseSector(addr), return DL_FLASH_SUCCESS.
impl.trap: Never erase or program the bank the program runs from (the SDK flash example says so). A tool that loads the program may erase whole banks: a load that erases only bank 0 leaves the data in bank 1 alone.
impl.check: a counter read after a software reset equals the last value written
impl.cite: AM13E2x SDK 26.01.00.03 examples/driverlib/flash (main.c, banks); SLAAE74B, Migration Guide From MSP430 MCUs to MSPM0 MCUs, Rev. B, June 2025, Tables 3-6 and 3-7 for the MSP430 side

impl.replace: Same log as the MSPM0 entry with 256 slots of 8 bytes per 2 kB sector; DL_Flash_program for a slot and DL_Flash_eraseSector when full.
impl.trap: As on MSPM0: a power loss between erase and first program loses the count.
impl.check: count after N resets is N more; the log wraps once without losing the count

impl.replace: Nothing to open: DL_Flash_program and DL_Flash_eraseSector take the address and do the unprotect. Delete the SYSCFG0 writes.
impl.trap: Flash protection registers (FlashEraseProtectionA and B) can lock sectors; check them if a call fails.
impl.check: program then read back

impl.replace: Nothing to port: the SDK's Device_Init sets the flash wait states for the 200 MHz clock.
impl.trap: Do not copy the 8 MHz FRAM limit.
impl.check: the program runs
impl.cite: SLAAE74B, Migration Guide From MSP430 MCUs to MSPM0 MCUs, Rev. B, June 2025, Section 3.4.2

impl.replace: DL_SYSCTL_setPowerPolicyRUNSLEEP() then __WFI() for sleep; DL_SYSCTL_setPowerPolicySTOP() for deep sleep with PD0 peripherals running; STANDBY0 or STANDBY1 for the lowest states.
impl.trap: Tested 2026-10-21: a program that entered STANDBY0 with only the watchdog interval timer as a wake source never woke, and the debugger could not connect afterwards (DSLite error -613, OpenOCD -613); a power-cycle of the probe's USB port, xds110reset and connect-under-reset did not recover it. Give STANDBY a GPIO wake pin, and keep a way back to a debuggable state (a delay before sleeping, a button to hold).
impl.check: the wake interrupt runs; the debugger still connects after a reset

impl.replace: STOP with WWDT in interval mode (power domain 0, LFOSC) as the wake source: DL_SYSCTL_setPowerPolicySTOP(). The SDK documents the watchdog as the STOP wake source and a GPIO as the STANDBY wake source.
impl.trap: Do not use STANDBY0 with only the watchdog timer: see power.sleep above.
impl.check: CPU-clock ticks across the sleep are a tiny fraction of the sleep time; the wake period matches a wall clock

impl.replace: DL_SYSCTL_setPowerPolicySHUTDOWN(); reset cause DL_SYSCTL_RESET_CAUSE_BORWAKESHUTDN on wake.
impl.trap: As on MSPM0, an image that sleeps at once cannot be debugged; stay awake for seconds first.
impl.check: reset cause reads wake from shutdown
impl.cite: AM13E2x SDK 26.01.00.03 examples/driverlib/sysctl/sysctl_low_power_modes; dl_sysctl.h reset cause names

impl.replace: NVIC_SystemReset(); DL_SYSCTL_getResetCause() returns the AM13 names (PORHWFAIL, POREXNRST, BORWAKESHUTDN, CPUSW, SYSDBG and others).
impl.trap: The enum names differ from the MSPM0 ones (BOR_WAKE_FROM_SHUTDOWN becomes BORWAKESHUTDN); the shim header does not map them.
impl.check: cause differs after a software reset from after power-up

impl.replace: WWDT through the SysConfig watchdog module in watchdog mode.
impl.trap: Window mode: open the window fully when porting a plain MSP430 watchdog.
impl.check: unfed watchdog resets; fed one does not

impl.replace: SysConfig WWDT in INTERVAL mode, sleepMode true, interrupt registered (registerInterrupt); the handler is named by SysConfig (APP_WWDT_0_INT_Handler for an instance named APP_WWDT_0). 15-bit period with divider 1 is 1 s.
impl.trap: Divider 2 with 15 bits is 2 s (the SDK example); set divider 1 for 1 s.
impl.check: one interrupt per second, no reset

impl.replace: SysConfig timer module (periodic mode) with registerInterrupt; the handler is named by the instance.
impl.trap: A timer in power domain 1 stops in STOP and STANDBY.
impl.check: count of interrupts in 10 s

impl.replace: DL_Flash_eraseSector and DL_Flash_program in bank 1 (2 kB sectors).
impl.trap: Never the bank the program runs from.
impl.check: read back equals what was written

impl.replace: Nothing after a normal reset. After SHUTDOWN wake the SDK sysctl example re-initialises the pins; follow it.

impl.replace: LFOSC (32 kHz internal) runs the PD0 peripherals in STANDBY; peripherals that run from it (WWDT) need no clock setup.
impl.trap: STOP and STANDBY limit PD0 peripherals to 4 MHz and 32 kHz.
impl.check: interval timer measured against a wall clock
